ops.title: capt-hook 9.24.0 (2026-07-16) flipped approve()/deny() to PreToolUse|PermissionRequest by default; all-tools subagent approve; live-verified on yasyf-home
ops.body:
capt-hook **9.24.0** (2026-07-16) shipped the events-default flip wave, closing the cc-squash/yasyf-home incident ([[cc-teammate-permissionrequest-forward-bypass]]):

- `approve()`/`deny()` default to `Event.PreToolUse | Event.PermissionRequest`; `llm_approve()` gained `events=` but stays dialog-only (judge off the hot path). External packs (cc-notes) inherited the fix with zero code change — hooks float via `uvx`.
- Fixes pack: second disjoint hook approves ALL subagent tools (MCP included) under a skip-permissions launch flag; guards = command-keyed recursive PayloadText scan + DangerousMcpTool verb tokens. Guards **decline, never block** — in a `defaultMode: auto` session CC natively runs a declined destructive command with no dialog (mechanism pinned by disambiguation; see cc-notes note 2f8c65f). Escalation if a hard guarantee is wanted: active `deny()`.
- Dispatch composition: block > rewrite > plain allow (a broad approve can no longer drop another pack's `rewrite_command`); warns ride along on winning allow/rewrite via `additionalContext`.
- **Settings deny/ask rules are NOT overridden by PreToolUse hook allows** — CC evaluates them regardless (verified against docs; earlier docstrings overclaimed).
- cc-context pinned its three approvers to `events=Event.PermissionRequest` (repo_find_nudge same-dispatch composition), pushed ahead of the release.
- Review: 4 codex (gpt-5.6-sol xhigh) finder/refuter rounds, each strictly narrower; fable synthesis rejected out-of-threat-model findings (leetspeak tool names). Ledger findings (agent_id not persisted, unbounded decisions.db) deferred to cc-notes backlog 7264174.

**Why:** PermissionRequest-only registration was a per-call-site trap (zero hooks run on forwarded teammate dialogs); flipping the default fixes every pack at once.
**How to apply:** never pin a `deny()` to PermissionRequest-only; verify with `capt-hook heartbeats` + decisions.db (NFS immutable-snapshot reads go stale — use `mode=ro`).
